cases.test_scenario: Verify that a guest submitting a name and an unregistered email in New User Signup! is taken to the Enter Account Information page
preconditions: User is not logged in (header shows Signup / Login).
The email address to be used is not registered on the site.

steps.action: Open http://automationexercise.com
steps.expected_result: Home page is displayed and the header shows the Signup / Login link.

steps.action: Click the Signup / Login link in the header
steps.expected_result: The /login page is displayed with a Login to your account section and a New User Signup! section.

steps.action: In the New User Signup! section enter a Name and an unregistered Email Address
steps.expected_result: Both fields accept the entered values.

steps.action: Click the Signup button
steps.expected_result: The Enter Account Information page is displayed, containing the Address Information section and the Create Account button; the URL is no longer /login.

cases.notes: Source: TCr1-S4~S7 (Register User) / prd.md FR-ACC-01. Header assertion for the guest role is folded into step 1 of this case.

cases.test_scenario: Verify that completing the account and address information and clicking Create Account produces the Account Created! confirmation and leaves the user logged in after Continue
preconditions: The Enter Account Information page is open for a new, unregistered email (result of FR-ACC-01).
The email carried over from step 1 is unique.

steps.action: On the Enter Account Information page fill the account information: Title, Name, Password, Date of Birth, and leave/keep the newsletter and partner-offer opt-ins as desired
steps.expected_result: All entered values are accepted and displayed in their controls.

steps.action: Fill the Address Information section: First name, Last name, Company, Address, Address 2, Country, State, City, Zipcode, Mobile Number
steps.expected_result: All entered values are accepted and displayed in their controls.

steps.action: Click the Create Account button
steps.expected_result: The Account Created! page is displayed with the text 'Congratulations! Your new account has been successfully created!' and a Continue link.

steps.action: Click the Continue link
steps.expected_result: The user is returned to the site in a logged-in state: the header shows 'Logged in as <name>' together with the Logout and Delete Account links.

cases.notes: Source: TCr1-S9~S16 (Register User) / prd.md FR-ACC-02. Which fields are actually mandatory and any format rules are undefined in the PRD (see open_questions), so the case fills every documented field.

cases.test_scenario: Verify that signing up with an already registered email shows the duplicate-email error and does not open the account information page
preconditions: An account already exists for a known email address (e.g. created via FR-ACC-01/FR-ACC-02).

steps.action: Open /login and, in the New User Signup! section, enter any Name together with the email address of the already registered account
steps.expected_result: Both fields accept the entered values.

steps.action: Click the Signup button
steps.expected_result: The error message 'Email Address already exist!' is displayed.

steps.action: Observe the page after the error is displayed
steps.expected_result: The user remains on the /login page; the Enter Account Information page is not displayed.

cases.notes: Source: TCr5-S4~S8 (Register existing email) / prd.md FR-ACC-03.

cases.test_scenario: Verify that logging in with correct credentials logs the user in and the header shows Logged in as <name>
preconditions: A registered account exists with known email and password.

steps.action: Open /login
steps.expected_result: The Login to your account section with Email Address, Password and the Login button is displayed.

steps.action: Enter the registered email address and its correct password in the Login to your account section
steps.expected_result: The credentials are accepted in their fields.

steps.action: Click the Login button
steps.expected_result: The user is logged in: the header shows 'Logged in as <name>' with the Logout and Delete Account links, and no login error message is displayed.

cases.notes: Source: TCr2-S4~S8, TCr4-S4~S8 (Login correct) / prd.md FR-ACC-04 AC1.

cases.test_scenario: Verify that logging in with incorrect credentials shows the login error and keeps the user on /login as a guest
preconditions: A registered account exists with known email and password.

steps.action: Open /login and enter incorrect credentials in the Login to your account section
steps.expected_result: The entered values are accepted in their fields.

steps.action: Click the Login button
steps.expected_result: The error message 'Your email or password is incorrect!' is displayed and the user stays on the /login page.

steps.action: Observe the header and page state
steps.expected_result: The user remains a guest: the header shows Signup / Login and not 'Logged in as <name>', and the Login to your account / New User Signup! sections remain visible.

cases.notes: Source: TCr3-S4~S8 (Login incorrect) / prd.md FR-ACC-04 AC2. Representative invalid inputs to cover in the same case (same expected result): registered email + wrong password; unregistered email + any password.

cases.test_scenario: Verify that a logged-in member clicking Logout returns to /login as a guest
preconditions: User is logged in (header shows 'Logged in as <name>' with Logout and Delete Account links).

steps.action: Click the Logout link in the header
steps.expected_result: The /login page is displayed containing the Login to your account and New User Signup! sections.

steps.action: Observe the header after logout
steps.expected_result: The header no longer shows 'Logged in as <name>', Logout or Delete Account; it shows the Signup / Login link (guest state).

cases.test_scenario: Verify that a logged-in member deleting the account sees the Account Deleted! confirmation and is returned to guest state after Continue
preconditions: User is logged in with an account that may be permanently deleted.

steps.action: Click the Delete Account link in the header
steps.expected_result: The Account Deleted! page is displayed with the text 'Your account has been permanently deleted!' and a Continue link.

steps.action: Click the Continue link
steps.expected_result: The user is no longer logged in: the header shows the Signup / Login link, and 'Logged in as <name>', Logout and Delete Account are no longer displayed.

cases.notes: Source: TCr1-S17~S18, TCr2-S9~S10 / prd.md FR-ACC-06. No confirmation step before deletion is described in the PRD (see open_questions).

open_questions: What are the password requirements for registration (minimum length, character classes), and what message is shown when a password does not meet them? The PRD defines no rule.

Which registration fields are mandatory, and what messages/behaviour are shown for empty or malformed input (e.g. Mobile Number format, Zipcode format, incomplete Date of Birth, missing Name/Address)?
Is email uniqueness and login case-sensitive — e.g. are 'User@Example.com' and 'user@example.com' the same account for the 'Email Address already exist!' check and for login?
Are Name and Email values trimmed of leading/trailing whitespace on signup and login, and does a trailing space in an email cause a duplicate-account or login failure?
Does a login attempt with an unregistered email show the same 'Your email or password is incorrect!' message as a wrong password, or is a distinguishable message intended?
Is the account deleted immediately without a confirmation prompt, and is any recovery or grace period intended after 'Your account has been permanently deleted!'?
After an account is deleted, can the same email address be used to register a new account immediately, and are previously used credentials rejected?
What should happen when a logged-in member navigates directly to /login or the signup section — is a redirect, the login page, or an error expected?
Is the login session remembered across browser restarts (persistent cookie) or does it end when the browser is closed?
